## [1.4.1](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/compare/v1.4.0...v1.4.1) (2026-11-19)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* **shared:** encode zeroed tween duration register by width and match range invokes ([2cce056](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/2cce056a40285f82578084b55493deb962fcca70))
* **jiohotstar/remove-topbar-switcher:** compute target-branch index after the 25f insert ([9b5b9ec](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/9b5b9ec5c390cb91d0fc5378b9f737f7dcd6e218))
* **shared:** guard nextInstructionIndex against int overflow ([01eb604](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/01eb6048f43ae74c15eb2e9521e466c0a9f17924))
* **jiohotstar/remove-topbar-switcher:** snap header expand/collapse to stop tab-switch jump [skip ci] ([d0fc69b](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/d0fc69b0cf101206af64ef12fdc3ef79710a45ce))

patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Bypasses app signature verification to allow API access.

patches.name: Enable all codecs
patches.description: Unlocks H.265, VP9, AV1 and 4K playback on capable devices.

patches.name: Enable screen mirroring
patches.description: Allows playback while screen mirroring or HDMI is connected.

patches.name: Enable screenshots
patches.description: Allows screenshots and screen recording, including during playback. Will not work on DRM-protected content (Widevine L1).

patches.name: Force HDR10
patches.description: Enables HDR10 and HDR10+ playback on compatible devices.

patches.name: Hide player buttons
patches.description: Hides selected buttons from the fullscreen player's bottom bar.

options.description: Hides the Shop / Order Food button.

patches.name: Hide watch page elements
patches.description: Hides watch page tabs (except Episodes) and the floating sponsored pill.

options.description: Removes the For You tab from the watch-page tab strip.
Removes the Jeeto tab from the watch-page tab strip.
Removes the Memes tab from the watch-page tab strip.
Removes the Live Chat tab from the watch-page tab strip.
Removes sponsored brand tabs (Shop, Order Food, etc.) from the watch-page tab strip.
Removes the floatingsponsored pill from the watch-page.

patches.name: Monochrome icon support
patches.description: Adds a themed-icon version of the launcher icon for Android 13+.

patches.name: Premium unlock
patches.description: Unlocks premium UI features, removes subscription nudges, and enables downloads.

patches.name: Remove ChatGPT Voice Assistant
patches.description: Strips out the integrated ChatGPT voice assistant module entirely.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes pre-roll, mid-roll, live-match and home-feed ads.

patches.name: Remove top bar switcher
patches.description: Removes the JioHotstar/Tadka switcher from the top of Home and snaps the header expand/collapse on tab switches.

patches.name: Anti-delete messages
patches.description: Prevents server-deleted messages from being removed locally.

patches.name: Anti-disappearing media
patches.description: Keeps view-once and self-destructing media viewable forever.

patches.name: Bypass content restrictions
patches.description: Bypasses restricted-content gates and channel no-forward checks.

patches.name: Enable premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium feature UI and shows the premium badge on self only.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Prevents typing status from being sent to other users.

patches.name: Remove sponsored messages
patches.description: Stops sponsored messages from being fetched and shown in channels.

patches.name: AMOLED theme
patches.description: Makes dark mode pure black for AMOLED screens. Light mode stays normal.

options.description: Hex color to use for AMOLED (e.g. #FF000000 pure black, #FF0A0A0A near-black).
Also force the status bar background to AMOLED on dark themes.
Also force the navigation bar background to AMOLED on dark themes.
Also blacken Material3 surface container colors (recommended for full AMOLED).

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium and removes Family-apps promos from the About screens.
